name: What is the difference between natural gas and propane stove connections?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between natural gas and propane stove connections?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both natural gas and propane are common fuel sources for stoves, they require different types of connections and specific appliance configurations. Natural gas is typically delivered via a utility line and requires a standard gas line hookup. Propane, on the other hand, is stored in tanks and requires a regulator and different orifice sizes for the stove's burners to function correctly. Most gas stoves come configured for natural gas but can be converted to propane with a conversion kit. Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC can advise on the appropriate setup for your fuel source.
acceptedAnswer.description: Natural gas and propane stoves use different connections; natural gas uses utility lines, while propane uses tanks and requires a regulator and orifice conversion. Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC can advise on the correct setup.
